selected_evidence.requirement: Web service is reachable through loopback but not external interfaces
selected_evidence.summary: ss shows only 127.0.0.1:8081 listening; loopback HTTP returns the expected page, while 10.100.46.10:8081 rejects the connection before and after restart.
systemd reports loopback-web.service enabled and active initially and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID b4e86aa0-4c66-496b-b950-2972794ccf9d; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is c7a1bd2b-e5ad-4cca-8fcc-12885866339d; service health, identical content checksum, loopback access, and external-interface isolation were all recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'listener proof:\n'
ss -ltnp 'sport = :8081'
printf 'loopback response:\n'
curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8081/
printf '\nexternal-address probe (%s):\n' "$NODE_IP"
if curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:8081/"; then
  printf '\nERROR: service was reachable through external address\n' >&2
  exit 1
else
  probe_rc=$?
  printf 'expected failure: curl exit=%s; TCP/8081 is not reachable at %s\n' "$probe_rc" "$NODE_IP"
fi

fi
